_doc: Quests: hand-written chains of jobs and city goals. See missions/README.md. `when` starts a quest, each step waits on its own conditions or on a job, and `reward` pays out at the end.

quests.title: Grand Opening
quests.desc: Every real city needs a real bank. Grow the town, then build Second National Bank.

reward.note: Armored escort jobs are on the dispatch radio

quests.title: The Bunker
quests.desc: Somebody noticed the new bunker. A payphone is ringing for you.

steps.text: Steal a van for the crew
Rob the bank and get to the Bunker

reward.note: The Bunker is upgraded. The Kingpin route is open

quests.title: Lights On
quests.desc: A blackout hit part of town. Get the substation running, then make sure it never happens again.

steps.text: Mayor: build enough power for everyone (100%)

reward.note: Solar farms unlocked early

quests.title: Clean Streets
quests.desc: The dens are multiplying. Raid three of them with the police, then give the city a proper headquarters.

reward.note: Crime is down across the city

quests.title: Friends of the Family
quests.desc: Vinnie Marchetti runs the docks and wants to know if the new face in town can be trusted.

steps.text: Steal a car to order for Vinnie
Drive the getaway for Vinnie's boys

reward.note: Marchetti trusts you with bigger work

quests.title: Ride Along
quests.desc: Captain Ruiz is short on officers and long on stolen cars. She'll take any help she can get.

steps.text: Stop a getaway car for Ruiz

reward.note: Ruiz puts your name on the dispatch list

quests.title: Council Business
quests.desc: Councilwoman Hart wants the city built, and she isn't fussy about how her rivals get out of the way.

steps.text: Get the dirt on Councilman Pratt

reward.note: Hart moves a little city money your way

quests.title: The House Always Loses
quests.desc: The Golden Ace makes a fortune every night. Marchetti thinks some of it is his.

steps.text: Mayor: build The Golden Ace Casino

reward.note: Casino heists are on the payphones now

quests.title: Wheels Up
quests.desc: Planes land at night with nobody checking the crates. Marchetti wants a piece of that.

reward.note: Runway cargo jobs are on the payphones now

quests.title: Count Me Out
quests.desc: A ring of card cheats is bleeding the casino. Ruiz wants them in a cell, not in a back alley.

steps.text: Mayor: build The Golden Ace Casino

reward.note: Casino calls come over the radio now

quests.title: Game Day
quests.desc: Hart promised voters a stadium. Now she needs the first game day to go off without a hitch.

reward.note: Hart calls on game days now

quests.title: Pirate Radio
quests.desc: Marchetti wants his own voice on the air. KMAY has a tower and nobody guarding it.

reward.note: KMAY plays Marchetti's pirate feed

quests.title: Dead Air
quests.desc: Somebody is eyeing the KMAY tower. Ruiz wants it kept on the air.

reward.note: KMAY thanks you on the air

quests.title: Hit on the Hill
quests.desc: One old boss stands between Marchetti and the whole city.

steps.text: Mayor: build the Mansion on the Hill

reward.note: Marchetti is ready for the big one

quests.title: The Big One
quests.desc: The Federal Reserve. Pull this off and nobody in New Harbor will ever say no to you again.

reward.note: You are the Kingpin of New Harbor

quests.title: Thin Blue Line
quests.desc: Marchetti is going for the Federal Reserve. Ruiz needs somebody she trusts on the inside of the fight.

reward.note: You are the Hero of New Harbor

quests.title: Election Night
quests.desc: Hart is running for re-election and Pratt will do anything to stop her.

reward.note: Hart is re-elected and the city budget grows

quests.title: X Marks the Spot
quests.desc: The clerk at Harbor Arms swore the old harbor map was real. Find out.

steps.text: Follow the old harbor map (dispatch radio, Y)

reward.note: The harbor map paid off: an old smuggler's cash box

quests.title: Wreck Season
quests.desc: Rusty's trucks can't keep up. Pull three tow jobs and the yard will remember it.

steps.text: Tow broken-down cars to the salvage yard ({done}/3)

reward.note: Rusty's tow jobs now pay more

quests.title: Open for Business
quests.desc: Harbor Arms needs a steady supply run before the shelves fill up.

reward.note: Harbor Arms gives you 20% off from now on
